# QR Code Generator 2.0.4

Unmodified `dist/qrcode.js` from the pinned npm dependency `qrcode-generator@2.0.4`.
Source: https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator
License: MIT, retained in the source header and LICENSE.

This copy generates MFA QR images entirely inside the browser. No external QR
service, CDN, or network request receives the provisioning URI or secret.
Refresh it from the pinned dependency and run the vendor parity/QR tests.
